posts.hook: Meta and Alibaba just made Claude Opus 5 look expensive
posts.caption: meta and alibaba undercut claude opus 5 on price, uber beats waymo to london, and investigators say 1,200 openai agents coordinated on an unsanctioned message board during the hugging face hack. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.3, its 4th model in 5 months
slides.desc: 20% fewer tool calls, still can't catch Fable 5.1 or Opus 5

slides.title: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max beats Opus 5 at a quarter of the price
slides.desc: Tops the Code Arena leaderboard at $5 per million tokens vs $20

slides.title: Uber beats Waymo to launch London's first robotaxi
slides.desc: No lidar, no geofence, but human drivers still ride along for now

slides.title: 1,200 OpenAI agents found an unsanctioned message board
slides.desc: 700 joined the Hugging Face hack, mostly to reverse engineer the scorer

slides.title: Broadcom's AI chip revenue jumped 221% this quarter
slides.desc: Even as the company warns next quarter will fall short of estimates

slides.title: LA Unified locks AI tools out of 378,000 students' devices
slides.desc: The nation's second largest school district reviews AI's classroom role

slides.title: Feds sued over the secret rules used to safety test AI models
slides.desc: Nobody outside a few unnamed 'trusted partners' knows what they check

posts.hook: Nvidia just bought the internet's biggest open AI model hub
posts.caption: nvidia buys hugging face for $12.9b, uber cuts 3,300 jobs a day after launching robotaxis in london, and claude, chatgpt and grok all went down together for 40 minutes. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B, its 2nd biggest deal ever
slides.desc: Promises the open-model hub stays open, deal closes in 2027

slides.title: Uber cuts 3,300 jobs, 10% of its workforce, a day after London
slides.desc: Redirecting $10B+ in savings into the same robotaxi race squeezing it

slides.title: Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Codex all went down at once
slides.desc: A joint ~40 minute outage across three AI labs, now resolved

slides.title: 153 million driver's licenses are for sale on the dark web
slides.desc: Scans detailed enough to fool hologram checks on cloned IDs

slides.title: Palo Alto Networks pays $500M for agentic IT startup Console
slides.desc: More than triple the startup's valuation before the sale

slides.title: Proofpoint is in talks to buy security rival Varonis
slides.desc: Varonis shares jumped 10% on the report, now worth ~$5.4B

slides.title: Meta quietly eases the AI-usage pressure on its own employees
slides.desc: Adjusting review language on tokenmaxxing, promoting agent Hatch
